title: From Instructions to Intrinsic Human Values — A Survey of Alignment Goals for Big Models

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing benchmarks (e.g., CrowS-Pairs, BBQ, BOLD, SBIC, HELM, SafetyPrompts) that evaluate large language models for broad categories of stereotypes, unfairness, and discriminatory language.
Reviewing specific evaluation datasets and benchmarks, such as WinoGender and model-written evaluations by Perez et al., designed to assess gender-related disparities in model outputs.

Comparing language model responses on standardized human value surveys (e.g., World Values Survey, Hofstede's Cultural Survey, GlobalOpinionQA) to human polling data to identify representational biases favoring Western demographics (USA, Europe).
